set.body:
R/fmri_lm_runwise.R:411 (parallel) and :485 (sequential) call
.fast_preproject(X_run) inside the per-voxel loop, but X_run does not depend on the
voxel - the same factorization is recomputed V times and thrown away. Line 299
already computes it once outside the loop.

.fast_preproject is not cheap: besides qr(X) it computes
Pinv <- qr.coef(qr_decomp, diag(n)) (R/fmri_lm_internal.R:122), an n x n solve,
O(n^2 p) flops plus an n x p allocation.

Measured: the voxelwise AR path runs ~146-200x the run-pooled path end to end
(2.48 ms/voxel at T=300, ~4 min per 100k voxels for a small design). Whitening is
only ~7% of that; ~80% is two QR factorizations per voxel, and roughly half of that
is this redundant one. Hoisting it is a free ~2x.

Related, not required: XtXinv_list holds a dense p x p matrix per voxel
(8*p^2*V bytes - 2.9 GB at p=60, V=1e5). An unused memory-lean alternative already
exists at R/fmri_lm_internal.R:690-745 and is called only from tests.
set.title: Perf: .fast_preproject(X_run) recomputed per voxel in both voxelwise branches
